text: I don't remember much of my dream from last night but what I do remember is the sound of bells added onto a song, a section of a song. I don't even know if I heard it but I knew it was there and when I woke up in the middle of the night, I woke up and it was dark and instead of recollecting my memory of that dream, my mind wandered to another dream I had some years ago where I had a dream about bells and it was probably the most beautiful dream I've ever had with no real emotion to it, just pure, pure sonic beauty. There was the sound of bells, kind of like church bells but without the without the association that comes with it of weddings or religion. It was just the sound of it and it was so captivating, so alluring, quite psychedelic, quite trippy with unexpected repetitions, reverb and echo. And since that dream I have learned to appreciate the sound of bells. I didn't used to like the sound of bells, I used to find it annoying, maybe due to the association I had with it or the frequency, I don't know. But since I've come to love the sound of bells, I have never, I didn't, I couldn't recreate that tune. Maybe you could, or maybe you could add some bells to this and it will go echo, echo and here's a bell and the same one is ringing again. It also reminds me of yet another dream I had, near that time I had the dream made out of bells, also a sonic dream but a lot more complex. I couldn't even begin to try to recall that tune that my mind made. It was like my whole being was embodied in that sound. It was like my whole being was embodied in that sound.
